target_customer: Indian SME exporters needing working capital
problem: Indian SME exporters wait for payment from large overseas buyers and lack collateral; Seawise discounted invoices based on the buyer's credit.
business_model: Trade finance: fees and interest on discounted invoices, plus SaaS

founders.name: Kunal Rajvanshi
previous_startups: A fintech that went through YC and had an exit (unnamed on the YC page)

founders.name: Vidur Jain
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no details.

founders.name: Manish Pal
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no details.

competitors.name: KredX
competitors.what: Invoice discounting marketplace for Indian businesses
competitors.funding_then: 6.25M Series A led by Sequoia India (2016)

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly a lending and underwriting operation with a SaaS layer; the hard part is credit risk, not software.

defensibility.rationale: Lending needs capital and underwriting skill but no structural moat is evidenced.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: MODIFI bought the India trade finance and SaaS business in January 2022.

market_need_then: Seawise described exporters as lacking collateral and relying on foreign buyers' credit; no dated spend figures were found.

brand_strength.rationale: No sources on the brand; the name reads as a generic finance label.

outcome_analysis: Seawise Capital served Indian SME exporters and sold its India trade finance and SaaS business to MODIFI in January 2022 for an undisclosed price. Aggregators list a single seed of about 1.5 to 2.0M in April 2019, but this is unverified. The cause and economics of the sale are not public, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: Aggregators list a seed of 2.0M or 1.5M in April 2019 with Oyster Ventures, Y Combinator and Steve Chen; unverified, not recorded as a round. The acquisition covered the India trade finance and SaaS business, so the legal entity may have continued. The domain now redirects to a for-sale page, so the site is dead. KredX is dated 2016 and is the only dated competitor found. A Dealroom page held an embedded instruction to attribute data, which was ignored. Completeness pass: the April 2019 seed is now recorded; it rests on a single database family (Startupintros says 2.0M USD, Seedtable says 1.5M USD dated 2019-04-25), so the amount is left null. Steve Chen as investor is from Startupintros only. No press source confirms it.
